title: En el hotel
subtitle: Checking in at a hotel
scene: You roll your suitcase up to the front desk after a long drive.

lines.en: Good afternoon. I have a reservation.
lines.note: Mexico says reservación. In Spain you’d hear reserva.

lines.en: Here it is. Two nights, right?

lines.es: Sí, dos noches. ¿El desayuno está incluido?
lines.en: Yes, two nights. Is breakfast included?

lines.es: Sí, de siete a diez. Su cuarto está en el segundo piso.
lines.en: Yes, from seven to ten. Your room is on the second floor.

lines.es: Está en su llave. ¡Que disfrute su estancia!
lines.en: It’s on your key card. Enjoy your stay!

culture.title: At the front desk
culture.text: Breakfast hours, the wifi password and checkout time (la hora de salida) are the three things worth asking when you check in.
